### Truth and Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/truth-and-love
Passage: 2 John 1:1-3
Points:
- John opens his epistle by emphasizing that authentic Christian discipleship requires both truth and love together.
- Early believers provided hospitality to traveling teachers, making doctrinal discernment essential so false teachers were not supported.
- Truth and love are inseparable: departing from love betrays the truth, and abandoning truth is unloving.
- Believers must guard against using sound doctrine as a weapon without love, as well as failing to lovingly address sin.

### The Truth of God
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-25-2021.html
Passage: 2 John 1:2
Points:
- When divine truth enters the heart, it takes permanent residence and governs the believer as the master of the house.
- The promise that God's truth abides forever gives Christians unfailing comfort, strength, and joy through every season of life.
- Unlike earthly knowledge that people outgrow, saving truth continually humbles believers while securing their hope in Christ.
- Believers must extend warm fellowship wherever truth is embraced, contending against error while actively loving fellow Christians.
